source_manifest.consensus_inclusion: Upstream main_candidate, oos_doorway_exploratory and stable_nonorthogonal_separate; report separately
source_manifest.privacy: This alias panel omits raw IDs, comments, photographs, task URLs and mappings; authorized mappings/comments are separately public in the repository (2026-10-01)

plan.real_selection_review: first draft included comment candidates; corrected before accepted rerun: exclude comment-only candidates and prioritize explicit annotation marks; no metric/GT criteria
plan.source_coordinate: C: continuous 1024x512; explicit P equivalent is C-0.5
plan.raster_sampling: output pixel centres, independent of input coordinate phase
plan.zero_depth_detail: limit geometry with two distinct collinear inserted nodes; positive depth has four detail nodes; unmatched identities reported, no coincident zero edges
plan.localization_corner: SE: shared x, bottom y toward horizon, top y toward horizon, separately

real_selection.order: scope/detail: annotation mark, image explicit tag, existing ledger, then image code and record alias; other categories: image code then record alias
real_selection.population: confirmed rings AND retained; gates copied, never changed
real_selection.evidence: explicit annotation marks, image explicit tags/existing ledger or explicit scene states; comment-only candidates excluded; missing is unknown
real_selection.forbidden: no GT distance, difficulty outcome or metric-based semantic labels

limitations: no real RMSE without source identity correspondence
column band is a declared bottom-first-hit and linearly interpolated wall-top proxy
non-flat top does not define a measured roof or volume
finite boundary quadrature may miss detail; max is sampled, never Hausdorff
no weights, clustering, consensus, personnel totals or training
